integrity: Stationary inclusion formula and coupling inequalities are proved analytically and cross-checked against exact rational small-system calculations; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives a sharp exponential rate of the mean for fixed c>0 and p=c/n, not an exact prefactor, hitting-time weak limit, or general nonuniform sampling or erasure law.
title: Critical-loss exponential rate for the careless coupon collector
